author: CBR
description:
Dante’s humor in Devil May Cry is not just attitude. Johnny Yong Bosch explains how Dante’s jokes, confidence, and cocky personality may be hiding deeper pain as more of the character comes to the surface. 

This Heroes Journey Short breaks down the darker side of Dante, his antihero energy, and what his humor reveals about where Devil May Cry could take him next.
